_comment: Essence Depleter converts mana into life loss: '{1}{C}: Target opponent loses 1 life and you
gain 1 life.' No {T} and no sacrifice, so it is repeatable within one turn -- the structural
difference from Shivan Gorge, which needs a fresh untap for every single activation.
Opponent at 4, and eight mana of which four are colourless: four activations exactly, so the
kill lands this turn. The Depleter is left SUMMONING SICK on purpose (it also cannot attack
here) -- CR 302.6 restricts {T} abilities and attacking, and this ability has neither, so a
just-wished Depleter draining the turn it arrives is legal. That is the exact case the old
`taps = mode != SacDraw` shortcut would have silently forbidden.
our life ends at 23: the drains' lifegain rider, net of one point of Brushland pain paid for a
coloured tap. That rider is inert for the clock, and asserting it is the only way the harness
can see it applied at all.
